description: Source code for the IAudioPolicyService interface implementation and transaction handling in Android's media framework.

classes.name: BpAudioPolicyService
classes.description: Proxy class implementing IAudioPolicyService interface for IPC communication.

methods.name: setDeviceConnectionState
methods.description: Sets the connection state of a specified audio device.

methods.name: getDeviceConnectionState
methods.description: Retrieves the connection state of a specified audio device.

methods.name: setPhoneState
methods.description: Sets the current phone state (e.g., in call, idle).

methods.name: setForceUse
methods.description: Sets forced usage configuration for audio policies.

methods.name: getForceUse
methods.description: Gets the current forced usage configuration.

methods.name: getOutput
methods.description: Obtains an audio output handle based on stream parameters.

methods.name: startOutput
methods.description: Starts audio output for a given handle and stream.

methods.name: stopOutput
methods.description: Stops audio output for a given handle and stream.

methods.name: releaseOutput
methods.description: Releases the specified audio output handle.

methods.name: getInput
methods.description: Obtains an audio input handle based on source parameters.

methods.name: startInput
methods.description: Starts audio input for a given handle.

methods.name: stopInput
methods.description: Stops audio input for a given handle.

methods.name: releaseInput
methods.description: Releases the specified audio input handle.

methods.name: initStreamVolume
methods.description: Initializes volume levels for a specific audio stream.

methods.name: setStreamVolumeIndex
methods.description: Sets the volume index for a specific stream and device.

methods.name: getStreamVolumeIndex
methods.description: Retrieves the volume index for a specific stream and device.

methods.name: getStrategyForStream
methods.description: Gets the audio focus strategy for a given stream.

methods.name: getDevicesForStream
methods.description: Gets the list of devices associated with a stream.

methods.name: getOutputForEffect
methods.description: Gets the output handle suitable for applying an effect.

methods.name: registerEffect
methods.description: Registers an audio effect with the system.

methods.name: unregisterEffect
methods.description: Unregisters an audio effect.

methods.name: setEffectEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables an audio effect.

methods.name: isStreamActive
methods.description: Checks if a stream is active in the recent past.

methods.name: queryDefaultPreProcessing
methods.description: Queries default pre-processing effects for an audio session.
